Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft yesterday. Laura and I went through the MAP and a couple of the acceptance items raised questions from our side:

- How do you want to resolve ambiguous pass/fail cases for "concordance" where coverage is > 92% but edge-case F1 dips for rare categories?
- For performance, we need a concrete fallback path. If latency spikes during peak test windows, what counts as an acceptable rollback vs. an exception?

I've attached the version we annotated (MAP_Sentinel_Test_Matrix.xlsx) with our comments in yellow. We're aiming for a firm decision on acceptance criteria by EOD Friday so procurement can start paperwork.

Can you propose a short tie-breaker process that we can surface to legal/procurement? Also tagging procurement on the cc in case they want to weigh in on evidence artifacts.

Thanks —

Ben —

Appreciate the annotated workbook. Quick read-through and proposed path below (high-level so we can share with procurement/legal):

1) Primary acceptance tests (pass/fail):
   - Concordance: macro F1 >= 0.90 AND per-critical-category F1 >= 0.80
   - Throughput: sustained 95th pct latency <= 350ms for 1k QPS synthetic load (see performance notes)
   - Safety checks: no high-severity hallucination incidents during 2-day smoke window

2) Tie-breaker hierarchy (when one primary check is borderline):
   - Short-term: run a focused edge-case vignette suite (50 targeted cases). If model improves cross-metric by >=3 pts, treat as pass.
   - If vignette run is inconclusive, use an independent adjudication panel (1 product, 1 ML, 1 customer SME) with documented rationale.
   - If panel disagrees, revert to conservative outcome: pass only if product + ML agree (customer SME tie-breaks in favor of customer).

3) Sentinel tests (what we will run nightly during the trial):
   - Regression smoke (10 canonical queries)
   - Edge-case probe set (50 cases, highlighted in sheet)
   - Latency sampling and anomaly alerting (DR threshold: 500ms)

4) Evidence package for procurement/legal:
   - Test logs (timestamped run, raw outputs)
   - Confusion/failure reasons with sample golden annotations
   - Post-hoc adjudication notes (if any)

Marissa — can you attach the updated MAP PDF and the sentinel matrix we discussed? Karthik — can you confirm the 95th pct numbers I used and add the quantization/instance-profile for the trial runs?

If that looks good to Veridian, we can lock the MAP and schedule the 90-minute runbook review on Monday.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Markus / Marissa / Ben —

Quick confirmation on the performance numbers and a few specifics for the sentinel runs:

- 95th pct latency target: 350ms measured on the customer-shaped synthetic (mix: 60% short prompts, 40% long prompts; seq len median ~128).
- DR threshold (automatic rollback trigger): sustained 95th > 500ms for 10 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 1.5% over same window.
- Resource profile: single p4d-equivalent node for baseline; we'll run 1-hr smoke at 1k QPS (bursting to 1.5k QPS) during the acceptance window.

Acceptance tests (execution notes):
- Edge-case vignette rerun: run before/after any model config change. If pre->post delta in critical-category F1 >= 3 pts, mark as improved.
- Adjudication: we'll capture adjudicator votes in a CSV and include short notes (required by procurement).

I've pushed the updated sentinel matrix and the perf-profile into the Drive link Markus included. Also added a small script that exports the raw latency histograms we promised.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
